blurb: Rogue Marine Rentals offers premium jet ski, pontoon, and boat rentals throughout Muskoka and the Trent-Severn Waterway. They provide local knowledge, guidance, and tour options to make your day on the water easy and memorable. Rentals include dockside orientation on safe operation, local boating rules, and safety procedures.
extraNote: Booking and payment information securely processed through trusted booking partners · Delivery and pick-up available upon request at your location or at 3214 Port Severn Road, Port Severn, Ontario.

quotes.text: We had rented a boat and trailer ( an older bow rider ) at a different location, we needed it to get to an island in Muskoka we had use of for a week and they cancelled at last minute. Found John at Rogue Marine and am I glad we did. We rented a brand new pontoon boat and trailer ( Legend ) for a week from Rogue Marine. Great boat and great experience. Dealing with this company was very straightforward and fair. On time and no surprises. I would definitely rent again from Rogue if I needed a boat ( or Seadoo). Thank you John.

John was great came out of his way to make thinks easier for me! Having fun in the lake lifting the machine I dipped in the lake and lost a key!!! Fun times, John was cool about it, I told him what happened, he said it was originally a charge of 250, which I paid for. Later he actually returned 160 because it was actually cheaper than 250 which was cool! Good man! Thanks for your service!!

We had an amazing time renting Seadoos from John and Rogue Marine Rentals. John was very informative about the Lake and told us the great places to go out on the Seadoo. The price cannot be beat, and we were allowed to have the Seadoos for as long as we wanted until the sun went down. Would 100% recommend this company to anyone who is looking for a fund activity in the Muskoka's!

We had an amazing experience with John and Rogue Marine Rentals! He made renting so easy and we had an absolute blast on the water! The Seadoos themselves were brand new and we were able to have them for a couple days. Not to mention they were a great price versus what you would normally pay for in Muskoka! Great experience overall, will be using again.

AMAZING, AMAZING, AMAZING! Perfect service with the best of the best rentals! John is very very helpful, reasonable and always wants the best for his customers! Thank you so much once again John for making our getaway the best! 10/10 recommend if you want to have a fun time and also be very safe/cared about!

John was an excellent guide on the Severn River! We took a pontoon tour for my Grandpa’s 95th birthday to bring back memories of his summers in the 30’s. The boats were clean and looked new. The Sea.doo rental was also great!
